p.i: istit in diaphano densiore, ratione fractionis sub maiore comprehenditur angulo. & in loco etiam propiore cernitur, ideoq; apparet maior. Demon-stratur hoc à Vitellione lib. 9. opticæ.

main_text.head: Præcedentis argumenti declaratio, sequentibus figuris patet.
main_text.p: [Figures: a diagram of a star, rays and an eye above a sphere; below, a framed three-panel woodcut of moon, star, rays, a standing figure, and a coin marked MONETA; below that a lettered diagram with points A, B, C, D and the caption SECVNDA.]

page.notes: The lower-right handwritten marginal note ("exm à g ... ") is faint and illegible. Diagram letters A, B, C, D are in a lighter brown ink, likely colour-printed or a later addition. The caption "SECVNDA" appears as "SECVN" with the last letter partly obscured. The marginal number 10 is handwritten or small and uncertain.
